name: Ryoujoku★Kazoku System
source:
On his summer vacation, the main character receives an invitation from a well-known company. The assignment is to choose among four women to play the "mother" and "younger sister" roles, then to live with them in a fake family in the role of the "eldest son". 

The invitation ends with a note that other than murder, everything is allowed...

Features the Cast Change System so that you can play the game multiple times with different characters in different roles.
translation:
暑假期间，主人公收到了一家知名公司的邀请。任务是从四名女性中选择“母亲”和“妹妹”的角色，然后以“长子”的身份与她们组成一个假家庭共同生活。

邀请函的末尾注明：除杀人之外，一切皆可……

本作拥有角色替换系统，可以用不同的角色扮演不同的身份多次游玩。
